高品質アニメ映像。高密度3Dトゥーン／セルルックによる映画的アクションRPGの高速剣戟。劇場版クラスのキーアニメーション、上質なコンポジット、透明感のある照明、密度の高い背景美術。8秒の短尺で、浮遊刀の猛攻、防御、回避、反力、包囲、最大衝突を高密度に連結する。

【参照画像と人物固定】
@1は一人目、キャラクターAの参照画像。
@2は二人目、キャラクターBの参照画像。
ソース参照画像のキャラクターを参照し、それぞれ同じ人物として維持する。参照画像はキャラクターの顔、目の形、虹彩色、髪型、髪色、衣装、装飾、体格、シルエット、雰囲気、キャラクターカラー、武器意匠だけに使用する。参照画像そのものの背景、部屋、家具、ポーズ、画角、フレーミング、文字、分割レイアウトは再現しない。
二人は全編でそれぞれsame person、same character identity。表情、視線、口元、姿勢、呼吸、自然な髪と衣装の揺れだけ変化してよい。特徴混合、顔の平均化、髪色交換、衣装交換、武器交換、体格変化、別人化、クローン化、分身、追加人物を発生させない。

【世界観と舞台の自動調整】
戦闘内容、位置関係、動作、力関係、刀数、カメラ構造は固定する。背景、小物、建築様式、床材、天候、照明、色味、粒子、環境エフェクトのみ、@1と@2のキャラクターデザインに合わせて再設計する。

二人の衣装、装飾、武器、素材、模様、固有色、モチーフから、両者が自然に存在できる一つの映画的戦闘舞台を新規構築する。学園都市、宮殿、神殿、庭園、幻想都市、工業施設、近未来空間などから最適な舞台を選ぶ。ただし参照画像の背景は直接コピーしない。

床には反射、水滴、砂塵、雪、花弁、火の粉、魔力粒子など、世界観に適した接触表現を配置する。欄干、柱、ガラス、樹木、機械構造、魔法装置、発光線などの小物は舞台に適したものだけを使う。背景は人物より一段暗くし、顔、シルエット、刀の軌道を明瞭にする。
キャラクターAの固有色を攻撃側のキーライト、浮遊刀のオーラ、斬撃残光へ使用する。キャラクターBの固有色を防御光、反撃残光、補助光へ使用する。両者の色は混ぜず、明確に識別できる状態を保つ。

【画風固定】
細く繊細な色付き輪郭線。顔、髪、衣装、武器に明快な二段から三段のセルシェーディングと透明感のある中間影。瞳は多層ハイライト、髪は繊細な束感、衣装は刺繍、レース、装甲、鎖、宝石、金具など、参照画像に存在するディテールを高密度に描く。

布、革、金属、宝石、ガラス、床を異なる反射率と粗さで描き分ける。太い黒輪郭、平坦な単層セル影、簡略TVアニメ、汎用3D美少女顔、プラスチックCG、低密度背景、半写実、実写、くすんだ色、画風混合にしない。参照画像の画風はコピーせず、高密度3Dトゥーン／セルルックへ統一する。

【武器固定】
キャラクターAは手持ち刀一本と、身体の周囲に浮かぶ四本の浮遊刀を使用する。浮遊刀はAの上、下、左、右を囲むように配置する。キャラクターBは手持ち刀一本を使用する。映像全体の刀は合計六本に固定する。

参照画像の武器が刀ではない場合も、その武器の色、素材、意匠、装飾、モチーフを継承した刀へ再設計する。
浮遊刀は刀身、鍔、柄が接続された完全な一本の刀。攻撃時のみ明確な飛翔軌道で動き、接触または回避後はAの周囲へ戻る。増殖、消失、融合、変形、余分な刀の追加を行わない。切っ先や刀身だけを独立回転させない。手持ち刀は柄だけを握り、刀身を手で掴まない。

【浮遊刀エフェクト】
四本の浮遊刀はキャラクターAの固有色を中心とした薄い炎状、霧状、粒子状、電光状のオーラを纏う。表現形式はAの世界観に合わせるが、必ず刀身へ密着させる。移動方向へ短い尾を引き、巨大な独立レーザーや別個の光線にしない。斬撃残光は刀の掃引面に密着した湾曲残光として発生する。

【力関係】
キャラクターAは冷静に主導権を握る格上。四本の浮遊刀を時間差で操りながら、自身も手持ち刀で前進する。キャラクターBは高い剣技で猛攻を弾き、避け、受け流し、反撃を試みるが、攻撃方向が連続して変化するため徐々に押される。Aだけが前進し、Bだけが後退する非対称な移動を維持する。
【カメラ】
固定横視点ではなく、浮遊刀越しの斜め低角度、Bの肩越し、接触点の近距離、接触点を軸にした約60度の回り込み、最終衝突へ迫る斜め低空カメラを使用する。浮遊刀のレンズ前通過、環境粒子、床から跳ねる飛沫、刀光を短い遮蔽ワイプに使う。カメラと背景が回り、人物を無意味に回転させない。

【8秒の動作構成】
Cut 1：
四本の浮遊刀がAの上下左右に静止した状態から開始。カメラは二本の浮遊刀の間を抜ける斜め低角度で、Aの顔、上半身、装飾、手持ち刀を見せる。Aは静かに前進し、視線だけでBを捉える。直後、右上の浮遊刀が加速し、Bの左肩口へ斜めに飛ぶ。

Cut 2：
Bの肩越し。Bは両手の刀で最初の浮遊刀を刀身中央同士の単一接触点で外側へ弾く。金属火花、両者の固有色の魔力火花、環境粒子、反力が発生する。弾かれた刀は弧を描いてAの周囲へ戻る。続いて左下の二本目が床すれすれを走り、Bは低く沈んで紙一重で回避。左上の三本目が斜め上から降下し、Bは刀を返して受け流す。

Cut 3：
環境粒子の遮蔽からAを斜め前方で映す。Aは止まらず踏み込み、手持ち刀で右下から左上へ斬り上げる。Bは後退しながら受け止める。二本の手持ち刀が一点で接触した瞬間、右下の浮遊刀がBの側面から侵入する。Bは肩を引いて避けるが、姿勢が横へ流れる。Aは接触を滑らせて解除し、さらに懐へ入る。
Cut 4：
接触点を中心にカメラが約60度回り込む。Bは反力を利用して返し斬りを放つが、Aの浮遊刀一本が側面から接触し、Bの刀を上へ逸らす。Aは手持ち刀を左上から右下へ振り下ろす。Bは急いで受け止めるが、足元が滑り後方へ押される。残る三本の浮遊刀がBの左右と上方へ散開し、退路を狭める包囲構図を作る。

Cut 5：
斜め低空カメラ。左手前に前進するA、右奥に押し込まれるB。Bは最後の反撃として踏み込む。Aも前進を止めず、左下から右上へ上昇斬りを放つ。二本の手持ち刀が中央の単一接触点で明瞭なX字を形成する。浮遊刀一本がBの刀身へ側面から追加圧力を加え、残る三本は周囲で次の斬撃姿勢を取る。
Aの攻撃色とBの防御色が別々に立ち上がり、中心の狭い白熱核の外側に巨大な二色のX字色面を形成する。放射状の衝撃波、環境粒子、蒸気、火花が広がる。Bの後ろ足が滑り、膝が沈み、両腕と肩の防御線が崩れ始める。Aは低い重心のまま前へ力を通す。X字の発光が最大まで拡大し、Bの防御崩壊が始まった瞬間に即カット。戦闘継続。

【重大NG】
固定横の格闘ゲーム視点、左右対称の全身構図、鏡写しの同時ダッシュ、長い助走、長い鍔迫り合い、無意味な連続回転は禁止。刀はAの手持ち一本＋浮遊四本、Bの一本、合計六本を固定。浮遊刀の増殖、消失、融合、変形、身体への貫通、切っ先だけの独立回転は禁止。手で刀身を握らない。独立レーザー、第三の光線、二色融合、全画面白飛びなし。追加人物、文字、字幕、ロゴ、透かし、UI、音響生成なし。

# FOOD ANIME COOKING VIDEO

Use the provided 12-panel anime cooking storyboard @Image1
as direct sequential visual keyframe reference for the entire 15s animation.
Follow the exact panel progression and cooking flow while smoothly
interpolating all motion between poses.

## CONSISTENCY
Maintain the SAME kitchen environment, cookware, dishware, and hand appearance
throughout every scene — full visual continuity across the sequence.
Exactly five pork-wrapped asparagus rolls appear through the cooking scenes;
after cutting, the same 5 cm bite-sized pieces stay identical in shape and glaze
through the bento scenes.

## STYLE
beautiful food anime realism, lush painterly food rendering, warm kitchen lighting,
realistic cooking physics, accurate culinary movement, stylized but natural steam,
soft cinematic depth of field, subtle film grain, smooth editorial transitions.

## REALISM RULES
no flying vegetables, no explosive effects, no dramatic splashes,
no floating ingredients, no exaggerated anime action,
no faces, no full bodies — hands and food only,
all motion follows real physics,
the knife is always gripped by a hand, blade vertical when cutting, never floating.

## FOCUS
food texture realism, elegant hand movement, appetizing sizzle moments,
physically correct steam and liquid behavior, satisfying cooking progression.

## SCENE SEQUENCE
Scene 1 (0s–1.25s): Slender green asparagus spears, a tray of thin pork belly slices, and small glass bowls of soy sauce, mirin, and sugar rest on a wooden cutting board.
Camera: slow push-in. Motion: gentle steam of ambient kitchen air, a hand enters and lightly touches the asparagus bundle.
Scene 2 (1.25s–2.5s): Hands trim the woody bottom ends off the asparagus spears with a knife on the cutting board.
Camera: fixed. Motion: the knife presses down cleanly through the stem ends, cut pieces settle naturally on the board.
Scene 3 (2.5s–3.75s): Hands wrap one thin pork belly slice in a tight spiral around a single slender asparagus spear from bottom to top.
Camera: slow push-in. Motion: fingers rotate the spear steadily as the pork ribbon coils around it.
Scene 4 (3.75s–5s): A row of five finished rolls on a metal tray is dusted lightly with flour from a small sieve.
Camera: fixed. Motion: fine flour drifts down softly and settles on the rolls, the sieve taps gently.
Scene 5 (5s–6.25s): The five pale rolls are placed seam-side down into a hot oiled frying pan.
Camera: slow push-in. Motion: a gentle sizzle begins, tiny oil bubbles form along the edges of each roll.
Scene 6 (6.25s–7.5s): Chopsticks slowly turn the five rolls in the pan, the pork surface an even golden brown.
Camera: fixed. Motion: each roll rotates naturally under the chopsticks, faint steam rising.
Scene 7 (7.5s–8.5s): A small glass bowl pours the mixed soy-mirin-sugar sauce into the pan around the five browned rolls.
Camera: fixed. Motion: the dark sauce streams down, spreads across the hot pan and starts to bubble.
Scene 8 (8.5s–10.5s): ★ HIGHLIGHT — the sweet soy glaze bubbles and thickens, coating each of the five rolls in a glossy caramelized sheen: glistening tare sauce, rich amber reflections, fine bubbles clinging to the pork, soft steam curling upward.
Camera: slow push-in. Motion: the pan tilts slightly and the rolls roll gently through the reducing glaze, light glinting across the glossy surface.
Scene 9 (10.5s–11.75s): On the cutting board, one hand grips a kitchen knife with the blade held straight and vertical, edge down, while the other hand steadies a glazed roll; the knife slices crosswise into 5 cm bite-sized pieces, cut faces showing the bright-green asparagus core.
Camera: fixed. Motion: a clean, natural downward knife stroke; the cut piece tips softly onto the board.
Scene 10 (11.75s–13s): Hands pack the 5 cm pieces upright with chopsticks into one compartment of an open wooden bento box, beside white rice with a pickled plum, rolled egg omelet, and a cherry tomato — green cross-sections facing up.
Camera: slow push-in. Motion: each piece is placed one by one, settling snugly into the compartment.
Scene 11 (13s–14s): A spoon lightly drizzles the remaining thick glaze over the pieces in the bento box, followed by a sprinkle of white sesame seeds.
Camera: fixed. Motion: the glaze flows slowly off the spoon, sesame seeds fall and scatter naturally over the glossy surface.
Scene 12 (14s–15s): The finished bento box, the glossy pork-wrapped asparagus pieces packed neatly beside white rice, gentle steam rising in warm light.
Camera: slow pull-out. Motion: soft steam drifts upward, warm light catches the shiny glaze.

## AUDIO
Warm homemade-bento mood BGM: cozy lo-fi jazz, 85–90 BPM, brushed drums,
mellow electric piano, soft upright bass — gentle and comforting, like a
weekday morning kitchen.
ASMR cooking sounds synced to action: knife trimming taps on the wooden board,
the soft wrap of pork slices, fine flour sifting, oil sizzling as rolls hit the pan,
chopsticks turning rolls, sauce pouring and bubbling as the glaze reduces,
clean knife cuts through the glazed rolls, pieces nestling into the bento box,
thick glaze drizzling, sesame seeds lightly scattering.

## NEGATIVE
NO SUBTITLES. NO TEXT ON SCREEN. NO CAPTIONS.
NO OPENING TITLES. NO END TITLES. NO WATERMARKS.
NO UI ELEMENTS. NO SPEECH BUBBLES.

seedance:3d-cg-seedance-2-5-2453b4b4307a.prompt: 人设修仙武者：年轻男性，身姿挺拔，气质清冷出尘、仙风道骨；御剑飞行双脚踏着巨剑剑身上，处于战斗施法状态，先后单手结印、双手结印。足下巨剑：宽大厚重，剑身泛寒光，可一分为五，在修仙武者脚下呈扇形展开。巨型妖兽：穷奇外形的庞然巨兽，体型如小山般巨大，四足粗壮、巨爪如柱；处于发狂肆虐状态，四爪先后被锁、挣扎咆哮。场景玄幻仙侠架空世界，一片人迹罕至的荒山野地作为主要空间环境参考，开阔荒原，远处连绵荒山轮廓，偶有碎石与低矮枯木。战斗后期巨兽头顶上空汇聚雷云。画面风格3D CG 高精度建模动画，国漫精品剧集质感；玄幻仙侠题材，写实 CG 建模与毛发皮肤细节，仙术法阵与雷霆特效能量感强烈；宏大战斗场面调度，史诗感。影调开阔荒原大场景、宏大空间纵深；主发光源来自法术能量：巨剑分身寒光、金色法阵明亮金辉自地面向上映照巨兽身型、白紫色雷霆爆裂闪光；雷云汇聚后环境被云层阴影笼罩、明暗对比加剧，法阵金光与雷光交替勾勒妖兽与武者的轮廓；妖兽挣扎时尘土飞扬、暗部细节增多。视觉参考参考国漫《灵笼》《凡人修仙传》CG 剧集视觉质感：高精度角色建模、材质与光影写实、仙术特效的能量流动与光效层次、大场景运镜调度。全局约束无字幕、禁止生成字幕。分镜1，0s-2s，大远景，固定镜头，高机位轻微俯拍，从年轻修仙武者身后拍摄，武者脚踏巨剑剑身御剑悬停在空中位于画面的左上角，镜头视线聚焦下方的荒原野地：一头穷奇外形的巨型妖兽正在荒地上发狂肆虐，挥动巨爪拍碎地面、仰头咆哮，扬起大片尘土碎石；音效：妖兽低沉咆哮、爪击地面的闷响、碎石飞溅声。分镜2，2s-4s，中近景，固定镜头，聚焦悬停空中的武者上半身近景，武者目光一凝，随即抬手单手结印，口唇快速念出咒语「分则能成！」；音效：低沉咒语吟诵声。分镜3，4s-5s，切换武者脚下巨剑特写，固定镜头，脚下的巨剑剑身泛起光纹、嗡鸣震动，随即一分为五，在修仙武者脚下呈扇形展开，巨剑本体仍位于武者脚下；音效：剑身震颤金属嗡鸣。分镜4，5s-8s，大远景→妖兽四只巨爪的局部中景，荷兰角，快速跟拍，镜头紧密跟随四把分身巨剑的飞射轨迹跟拍。四把分身巨剑如流光般疾速飞射而下，分别命中妖兽四只巨爪，击中瞬间化作虚灵形态的灵光锁链缠绕锁紧四爪；妖兽四爪被锁、挣扎甩动却无法挣脱，仰头怒吼；音效：剑气破空声、锁链缠绕铮鸣、妖兽挣扎怒吼、地面震颤闷响。分镜5，8s-10s，特写，固定镜头，聚焦武者胸前结印的双手。高空中的武者双手抬起、十指交叠快速多次结印，法力凝聚的微光在掌间亮起，随即放声暴喝；对白：修仙武者（怒喝）：「雷光咒！」；音效：灵力汇聚的低沉嗡鸣、武者暴喝声、妖兽持续咆哮。分镜6，10s-11s，全景，仰拍后拉。妖兽脚下的地面骤然亮起一个与它身型投影同样巨大的金色法阵，符文旋转展开、金光上涌，将挣扎的妖兽笼罩其中；音效：法阵启动的深沉轰鸣、能量流动的嗡嗡声。分镜7，11s-15s，大远景，仰拍。妖兽头顶上空乌云迅速汇聚，雷云翻滚、电光在云层中窜动，天色骤然压暗；一道巨大白紫色雷霆从乌云中迸发，自天而降击中巨兽身体，法阵金光与雷光同时爆发，妖兽身形被耀眼光芒吞没、剧烈震颤；音效：雷云翻滚闷响、电流滋啦声、雷霆炸裂巨响、轰鸣回响、大地震动。全局配乐：纯音乐 + 无词吟唱0s-2s：琵琶轮指 + 二胡紧张颤音长音，低音提琴拨弦脉冲；旋律短促、小二度游移（不安定感），音量中等、密度低2s-4s：琵琶扫弦 + 古筝十六分音符急奏，堂鼓+小钹进入密集节奏层，弦乐群齐奏推高4s-5s：大鼓滚奏渐密，铜管短促强音（"锁"的动作感），低频持续音垫底；妖兽咆哮处配乐主动让位——音量降、减旋律密度，给咆哮音效留空间5s-8s：只留低频持续音 + 箫孤音。打击乐静默、旋律消失8s-10s：古筝泛音 + 弦乐长音渐强，无词女声"啊——"进入（非歌词）；和声从暗小调切向明亮大三和弦的临时离调10s-11s：大鼓滚奏 + 定音鼓渐强，弦乐密集颤音，30-60Hz 低频持续轰鸣；旋律线消失，只剩节奏与和声爬升；11s-15s：大鼓+定音鼓+镲片同击，唢呐/铜管齐奏强音，琵琶古筝最高密度扫弦；雷光爆闪处配乐让位 0.3s 给雷声音效；结尾快速衰减至低频余震 + 箫尾音

seedance:seedance-2-5-8d136b59e95a.description: 公開アカウント「Hengtest H3 と Seedance シリーズ、結果は少し驚くべきものです... (7 つの超高品質プロンプト付き)」章...
seedance:seedance-2-5-8d136b59e95a.prompt: 人设女性：年轻漂亮，长发披肩，坐在出租车后排。角色状态：与男友分手告别，表面强撑微笑、内心悲伤压抑，最终情绪崩溃嚎啕大哭。场景出租车内部的后排车厢作为空间环境参考，前排副驾驶空位（前景局部失焦虚化）；侧车窗与后车窗均被雨水打湿；车窗外为城市街道夜景、霓虹灯光、淅淅沥沥的小雨。画面风格真人实拍质感的青春恋爱电视剧，现代都市写实服化道，细腻情感戏审美，情绪戏节奏克制。影调车内整体偏暗，窗外城市夜景与霓虹灯光透过雨打车窗，在车内形成流动的彩色光斑与明暗切片，勾勒女性面部轮廓与长发边缘；车窗玻璃上雨珠反光；夜景冷调为主，霓虹光斑冷暖交织。全局约束无字幕、禁止生成字幕。画面内容分镜 1，0s-6s，车内中景，固定机位，摄像机位于前排副驾驶位置朝后方拍摄；前景左下方为副驾驶空座椅背局部（失焦虚化），女性位于画面右侧三分线位置。她侧着脸望向右侧车窗外，轻咬下唇，微笑着与窗外人道别，窗外站着一名身穿灰色夹克黑色牛仔裤的男性，透过车窗只能看见男性的局部身体：对白：女性（轻咬下唇，微笑）：「就这样，不用送了。」随后她转头面向镜头，对前排司机说：对白：女性：「司机，开车。」说完她不经意地带出一声压抑的细微啜泣，随即轻轻舒了一口气，脸上仍保持着刚才的微笑。出租车随即启动，车身轻微震动一下，车辆起步向前开动，窗外男性朝着车窗挥手再见（局部入画），男性与窗外雨幕与霓虹灯光快速向后掠过。音效：淅沥雨声打在车顶与车窗，城市夜晚低缓的环境底噪；对白期间人声清晰突出；一声压抑的细微啜泣；轻舒气声；发动机启动声与车身轻微震动；轮胎碾过湿路面的起步声。分镜 2，6s-15s，切换车内后排近景，手持拍摄，轻微仰拍，镜头随行驶中的车身轻微晃动；焦点在女性肩部以上正面，她背后隔着被雨打湿而模糊的后车窗，城市街景与霓虹灯光逐渐远去。一开始女性脸上仍带着微笑，没有皱眉也没有哭，慢慢地她开始轻微皱起眉头，小幅摇了摇头，像是反悔刚才说出口的话；接着她的嘴角微微下压，抿紧双唇，眼眶开始泛红；她稍稍仰起头试图忍住，眼神有些游离地瞥向旁边车窗外；接着她终于再也压抑不住 —— 嘴角明显下垂，眉毛内收收紧，鼻子开始抽搐，眼神黯淡，眼眶湿润，泪水开始流出；然后她垂下头、微微蜷缩着肩膀，随即猛然仰头，嚎啕大哭，一边哭一边抬手擦去脸上止不住的泪水。整段为逞强微笑→压抑情绪→悲伤外泄→情绪大爆发的连续情绪变化，一镜到底。音效：雨声持续；行驶中发动机低鸣与轮胎碾过湿路面的沙沙声；呼吸渐重、吸鼻声；压抑啜泣转为放声大哭；手背擦拭泪水的摩擦声与衣料声。全局配乐雨夜分手情绪戏（15s 配乐轨，无歌词）0-6s 无BGM，只保留对白和环境声；6-8s 微笑→轻微皱眉 | 钢琴单音/两音动机从雨声里渗出，极弱 pad 垫底，像回忆浮上来；8-10s 摇头反悔→抿唇→眼眶泛红 | 钢琴变叹息式下行音型，大提琴长音进入；10-12s 仰头忍泪→眼神游离 | 小提琴组加入，和声加厚，钢琴分解和弦铺开；12-13.5s 嘴角下压→鼻翼抽动→泪落 | 情绪临界：弦乐揉弦+力度加强，钢琴和弦加重；13.5-15s 垂头蜷缩→仰头嚎啕大哭 | 段落峰值：弦乐齐奏主题，钢琴八度重音。

seedance:doc2-biscuit-ad.title: フルーツビスケットの電子商取引広告
seedance:doc2-biscuit-ad.description: フルーツ ビスケットの電子商取引広告ビデオでは、4 つのフレーバーのビスケットと対応するフルーツが幾何学的配列で配置されています。クライマックスでは、スローモーションでビスケットが開かれ、フルーツが現れます...
seedance:doc2-biscuit-ad.prompt:
Bright, colorful commercial-ad style, with fruit biscuits as the hero, featuring four flavors - strawberry, apple, grape, and orange. 
The biscuits and their matching fruits are arranged in a strongly ordered geometric array, the overall image clean, high-end, and strongly rhythmic. The opening quickly establishes visual focus with fruit, the music's downbeat cutting in. Then the different-flavor biscuits line up neatly, cut to close-up. In the climax segment, a biscuit is snapped in half, instantly entering slow motion, the fruit filling bursting open, crumbs flying, the juicy feel and grain impact magnified and showcased. A horizontal array forms a rhythmic parabolic toss, highlighting the orderly beauty and product richness. Then it quickly returns to fast-paced editing. At the end, the English text "One bite of crispness, a heart full of delight" cuts in rapidly word by word, paired with strongly rhythmic text motion and a product freeze, finally closing with a brand feel, the biscuits and fruit radiating outward, referencing, the image full of a young, energetic, delicious, share-worthy ad atmosphere.

seedance:doc2-biscuit-to-icecream-swap.prompt: 基于视频【@原视频】做局部编辑修改，保持原视频中水果的种类、形状、颜色、细节、位置、时间静止效果、运动效果、镜头运动、环绕轨迹、构图、光影氛围、画面质感、音频内容与整体节奏全部不变，只进行以下唯一精准修改：删除原视频中出现的所有【饼干】，包括【饼干】的形状、纹理、颜色、阴影与运动残影。在原【饼干】完全相同的空间位置、大小比例、冻结时刻和运动轨迹上，替换为【草莓味雪糕@草莓味图、苹果味雪糕@苹果味图、葡萄味雪糕@葡萄味图、橙子味雪糕@橙子味图】。【雪糕】严格参考瓶型、瓶盖、标签、色彩、材质、反光、包装细节与整体外观；掰碎的慢动作阶段，【雪糕】中间有粘稠果酱，雪糕碎屑飞溅。除“饼干替换为雪糕”外，其他所有画面音频内容必须全部保持原样；不要删除或新增帽子、服装、人物、台词、音效、文字、LOGO或水印。

seedance:case-251215797a14.description: キャラクター Kael Drayn の非常に速いペースのアニメ アクション クリップで、ハードコアな SF の美学と可変フレームが特徴です…
seedance:case-251215797a14.prompt:
KAEL DRAYN @[Image] — "Frontier Justice" | Action Sequence. 15-second montage, hyper-kinetic rhythmic editing, variable frame
rates.

Art Direction & Vibe: Premium key art. Unified style: high-end gritty sci-fi
anime render, sharp graphic linework, cinematic spatial lighting. Setting:
lawless outer-rim outpost, dusty streets, rusted corrugated metal, harsh desert
sun.

Color Discipline: Suppressed palette: sun-bleached beige, dry ochre, rusted
iron, muted olive. Accents: his terra-cotta skin/markings, searing crimson enemy
blaster bolts, and the blinding neon-green of his plasma sword. High contrast;
the plasma blade casts stark green rim-light on kicking dust. Atmosphere:
blowing sand, heat distortion, flying sparks, kinetic motion blur.

The Character: Locked design (match reference): KAEL DRAYN, Outer Rim Sentinel.
Patterned alien head-tails, dark facial markings, calm focused eyes. Earth-toned
tactical gear, draped olive cowl, utility belts, combat boots. Wields a
mechanical hilt emitting a neon-green plasma blade. Demeanor: disciplined,
precise, unshakeable — zero wasted movement amidst chaos.

Shot Design: Rotate combat grammar. Macros (thumb igniting hilt, green blade
melting a crimson blaster bolt, tactical boot pivoting in sand) to wide
acrobatic leaping strikes. Hard diagonals, dirty over-the-shoulder perspectives,
dynamic low-angle hero framing. Lighting: blistering harsh daylight, intense
neon-green ambient glow during strikes. 3 environmental combat frames: a
scorching blast-mark on an adobe wall, sliced metal debris falling, wind
sweeping dust over footprints.

Story Arc: Open on tense stillness. Omens: shifting shadows, a mercenary's
weapon clicking. Introduce in defense: mechanical hilt snaps up, blade ignites,
tight macro framing of rapid blaster deflection. Escalate through the
counter-attack: Kael fluidly advances through the crossfire, a blur of leaping
strikes and spinning green light trails carving through the dust. Resolve
climactic frame: Kael in a grounded low stance, sword sheathed, cowl blowing in
the wind, completely unbothered amidst fallen adversaries. High-velocity
whip-pans between beats; kinetic precision.

seedance:asmr-eb8937adce5b.prompt:
High-maintenance luxury beauty/skincare routine with sassy, condescending ASMR elements- seedance 2.0 prompt

CAMERA / LOOK: Propped iPhone/Mini DV camcorder footage on a sleek vanity mirror stand. Soft diffuse lighting, delicate lens flare, gentle zoom adjustments, subtle tape grain, polished high-end aesthetic. STYLE: High-maintenance luxury beauty/skincare routine with sassy, condescending ASMR elements. Paws delicately patting bottles, slow blinks, arrogant pauses. SUBJECT: Fluffy white Persian cat with a flat smushed face, emerald green eyes, wearing a tiny silk hair wrap. Smug, unimpressed expression, regal demeanor. SETTING: Marble bathroom vanity with expensive serum glass bottles, jade roller, plush velvet towel, warm vanity light bulbs. STORYBOARD: → (2s, medium shot) Adjusts camera angle with one claw. "Good morning to everyone except my human who woke me up 3 minutes early." → (1.5s, detail shot) Taps a glass serum bottle with front paw. Crisp clinking glass ASMR sound. → (1.5s, close-up) Slowly pushes serum bottle off the counter while maintaining eye contact with camera. Loud shatter/thud sound below. "Oops. Gravity works. Moving on." → (2s, detail macro shot) Softly licks back of paw and wipes ear in slow motion. Soft grooming ASMR sound. → (1.5s, close-up) Gazes into mirror, tilting head. "Skin is glowing, pores are non-existent. You're welcome." → (1.5s, medium handheld shot) Uses jade roller on forehead using tiny paw. "Reducing puffiness from sleeping 18 hours instead of 19." → (1.5s, macro detail shot) Sniffs a tub of catnip cream, letting out a delicate sneezed 'achoo'. → (1.5s, medium shot) Sits tall, smoothing chest fur with arrogant posture. "If you can't afford this routine, just say that." → (1s, ending shot) Slow blinks condescendingly into lens. "Don't forget to subscribe. Or don't. I don't care." → (1s, final shot) Swats camera violently off vanity counter. Video cuts to static grid. AUDIO NOTES: Glass bottle clinking, soft licking/grooming sounds, heavy purring sub-bass, arrogant posh voice with refined lip movements. REALISM & COMEDY NOTES: Photorealistic white Persian fur physics, subtle whisker twitches, natural cat slow-blinks, hysterical condescending tone paired with classic cat chaotic behavior (knocking things off tables).

seedance:case-50692082320d.prompt:
@referance image As first frame. A sharply dressed man in a dark blazer and black shirt stands facing a tall ornate mirror in complete darkness. His reflection stares back — but the reflection smiles while he does not.
0–2s: Medium shot, symmetrical composition — the man on the left, his reflection on the right. Camera holds perfectly still. A cold overhead spotlight illuminates only him and the mirror. His expression is stone-cold. His reflection slowly tilts its head and grins wider. In a deep voice with metallic reverb: "You're not me." haohaoxue:chinese-teahouse-portrait.description: 中国と西洋のスタイルを融合させたポートレート写真: アンティークの肘掛け椅子に座り、透明なティーカップを持ち、Apple Watch を身に着けている都会の女性たち…
haohaoxue:chinese-teahouse-portrait.prompt: Cinematic portrait of a modern Chinese woman in a traditional Chinese study-room setting. She sits relaxed in a classic rosewood circular armchair. Short wavy black hair, natural makeup, warm confident smile. Wearing an oversized brown wool sweater, Apple Watch on wrist, white wired earphones. Holding a glass tea cup with hot tea, visible steam rising. Background: classical Chinese wooden bookshelves lined with old books, decorative antiques, traditional lattice window with bamboo shadow outside. Warm golden amber cinematic light streaming from the window side. Color grade: warm browns, deep shadows, cozy afternoon mood. Shot on 85mm f/1.4, shallow depth of field. 9:16 vertical.

haohaoxue:beijing-landmarks-blueprint.title: 北京のランドマークビルの青写真立体ポスター
haohaoxue:beijing-landmarks-blueprint.description: 工学設計図と立体ミニチュア模型のハイブリッドビジュアルポスター。絵の片面は建築設計図の線画で、もう片面を破るとフルカラーの立体模型が現れます。
haohaoxue:beijing-landmarks-blueprint.prompt: Beijing city landmarks poster, half architectural blueprint technical drawing and half full-color 3D miniature model, paper tearing reveal effect at the boundary, gold foil accents. 3D miniature buildings: Temple of Heaven, Forbidden City, Bird's Nest stadium, CCTV headquarters twisted tower, Great Wall winding through mountains, Water Cube. Chinese red and gold color palette, cream blueprint paper background on the left. Large Chinese calligraphy brushstroke text Beijing and italic serif Beijing at bottom. Viewed from 45-degree angle on red textured surface. Cinematic depth of field on the miniature models. 9:16 vertical.

haohaoxue:province-3d-relief-map.title: 中国各省の 3D 地形視覚化地図
haohaoxue:province-3d-relief-map.description: 3次元地形省地図: 実際の起伏のある山岳地形、各県レベルの都市は異なるカラーブロック、省境、沿岸地域に分割されています...
haohaoxue:province-3d-relief-map.prompt: Photorealistic 3D topographic relief map of a Chinese province. The terrain is raised and sculpted showing actual mountain ranges, plains, and coastline geography in physical 3D relief. Each prefecture-level city region is filled with a distinct solid color: rich jewel tones — deep purple, warm orange-red, teal green, olive gold, dark amber, dusty blue, coral pink, sage green, warm slate. The outer border of the entire province and major river boundaries glow with electric neon blue light, as if lit from below. White bold Chinese city name labels float above each region. The province floats on a dark charcoal grey stone-textured base map showing surrounding geography (sea, neighboring provinces in grey). Dramatic cinematic lighting from upper left creating strong shadows on the raised terrain. Slightly aerial bird's-eye view angle. Ultra-realistic CGI render quality. 1:1 square.

haohaoxue:plush-toy-blueprint.title: IPぬいぐるみデザイン設計図
haohaoxue:plush-toy-blueprint.description: IPドールの工業デザイン青写真スタイル：方眼紙の背景、正面/側面/背面の3面配置、頭/体/4つのラベル…
haohaoxue:plush-toy-blueprint.prompt: Cute plush toy product design blueprint sheet. Aged cream grid paper background. durian fruit shaped kawaii plush toy character shown in three orthographic views: 正面 (front), 侧面 (side), 背面 (back). Pencil sketch outlines alongside detailed color render of the soft toy. Chinese dimension annotations with arrows: 头部 Xcm, 身体 Xcm, 腿部 Xcm, 刺长 Xcm. Additional small orthographic silhouettes in corners. The toy has big round cute eyes, soft fluffy texture, chubby proportions. Professional product design specification sheet aesthetic. 2:3 vertical.

haohaoxue:yunnan-hotpot-sticker.title: 雲南きのこ鍋ステッカーイラスト
haohaoxue:yunnan-hotpot-sticker.description: 黒背景ステッカー風食べ物イラスト：雲南野生キノコ鍋が主役。珍しいキノコの数々を深めの土鍋で炊き上げ、お箸でつまみます。
haohaoxue:yunnan-hotpot-sticker.prompt: Food sticker illustration on pure black background, white outline sticker border around the entire composition. Main subject: Yunnan wild mushroom hotpot in a rustic clay earthenware pot, golden amber broth bubbling, filled with premium wild mushrooms including matsutake, porcini, morel, chanterelle, king oyster mushrooms. Chopsticks lifting a large gorgeous mushroom with golden broth dripping. Watercolor-style illustration technique, vibrant warm colors. Upper left area: white irregular sticker shape containing large bold Chinese calligraphy brush text for Yunnan mushroom hotpot, smaller Chinese subtitle text, English subtitle YUNNAN WILD MUSHROOM HOTPOT. Bottom left: woven bamboo basket with fresh raw mushrooms and sliced raw meat. Overall warm appetizing color palette with black background creating drama. 1:1 square.

haohaoxue:fanceng-ink-portrait.title: 樊曾風水墨画
haohaoxue:fanceng-ink-portrait.description: 樊曾先生風の中国のフリーハンドのインク人物: 古代の文人や将軍の胸像、顔の特徴を輪郭を描く自信に満ちた大きな筆致、ミニマルな色彩 -...
haohaoxue:fanceng-ink-portrait.prompt: Chinese ink wash portrait in the style of master Fan Zeng (范曾). Half-body portrait of an ancient Chinese scholar literati. Confident bold brushwork defining facial features — sharp eyebrows, knowing expression, goatee. Very limited color palette: rich black ink for hair and details, cobalt blue wash for robes, vermilion-red accent on earlobes and lips. Vast white paper background as negative space. Traditional topknot hairstyle with headband. Ink robes loosely rendered with wet brush strokes — not tight or detailed. Artist red seal stamp (印章) and calligraphy signature lower right corner. The proud scholarly spirit of Tang and Song dynasty literati. 9:16 vertical.

haohaoxue:miniature-food-diorama.title: ミニチュア食品工房 ミクロの世界
haohaoxue:miniature-food-diorama.description: ティルトシフト写真のスタイルのミニチュアの世界: スケールのおもちゃのフィギュアが伝統的な食品工房で忙しく働いており、キャンディー/包/麺などを作っています...
haohaoxue:miniature-food-diorama.prompt: Hyperrealistic tilt-shift miniature diorama photography of a traditional Chinese traditional Chinese workshop. Tiny 1:87 scale figurines as workers wearing aprons, actively making maltose candy workshop. Miniature traditional workshop equipment: wok stoves, wooden barrels, bamboo steamers, display tables with food. Warm amber honey food tones dominate. Shallow depth of field — foreground sharp, background softly blurred. Overhead or slight aerial angle. Incredibly detailed — individual grain texture on food, wood grain on barrels, fabric texture on aprons. The magical charm of a Miniature Calendar photo. 4:5 vertical.

haohaoxue:chinese-architecture-exploded.title: 古代中国建築の分解構造図
haohaoxue:chinese-architecture-exploded.description: 中国の古典建築（紫禁城、天壇など）の分解分解構造図：中央は高精度3Dアイソメトリックレンダリングモデル、屋根・バケツ...
haohaoxue:chinese-architecture-exploded.prompt: Chinese imperial architecture exploded diagram infographic. Central subject: a Forbidden City main ceremonial hall (Taihedian) rendered as a highly detailed photorealistic isometric 3D model. Exploded view showing structural layers floating apart: glazed tile roof, elaborate dougong bracket clusters, red lacquer columns, painted ceiling medallion, marble terrace with balusters. White background. Technical blueprint drawings in corners: floor plan, elevation, cross-section. Chinese annotation lines with measurements pointing to architectural components. Gold, vermilion red, and deep teal color palette. JY DESIGN aesthetic — architecture education meets visual art. 9:16 vertical.

haohaoxue:quentin-blake-night-run.title: クエンティン・ブレイク 月夜に走るイラスト
haohaoxue:quentin-blake-night-run.description: クエンティン・ブレイクの特徴的な月明かりに照らされたスタイル: 広く青い水彩画の空、明るい満月、そして畏敬の念を抱く 1 人の人物...
haohaoxue:quentin-blake-night-run.prompt: Quentin Blake illustration style, moonlit night scene. A single expressive cartoon character running in fright or flying through the air — wild hair, bulging eyes, arms flailing. Dramatic wide blue watercolor sky wash filling the upper half, large full moon top right. Black ink loose energetic strokes swirling around the figure suggesting wind and movement. Bare tree branches in black ink at edges. Bottom half fades to white/cream paper. No background clutter — the character and moon are everything. The magical frightening energy of a Roald Dahl book cover illustration. 3:4 portrait format.

haohaoxue:dunhuang-silk-road-poster.title: 敦煌シルクロードの壮大なポスター
haohaoxue:dunhuang-silk-road-poster.description: 莫高窟を舞台にした中国文化の壮大なポスター。洞窟のドームに座る巨大な黄金の仏像、雲の中を飛ぶ妖精、古代の黄金の巻物…。
haohaoxue:dunhuang-silk-road-poster.prompt: Create a cinematic Chinese cultural epic poster with Dunhuang Mogao Caves theme. A colossal golden Buddha statue inside a cave grotto, hand raised in blessing mudra. Ancient Dunhuang flying apsara (飞天) with flowing silk ribbons ascending around the Buddha. A giant ancient Chinese manuscript scroll unrolls from the Buddha's hand and cascades down, its surface covered in beautiful calligraphy. A small Silk Road camel caravan walks along the scroll as if it were a road. Rich warm color palette: gold, amber, deep ochre, terra cotta red. Red silk ribbons flying dynamically. Cave walls covered in colorful Buddhist murals. Mystical mist and golden light rays. Large Chinese calligraphy title in gold at the bottom. 9:16 vertical epic scale.

haohaoxue:quentin-blake-cartoon.title: クエンティン・ブレイクの手描き漫画イラスト
haohaoxue:quentin-blake-cartoon.description: ロアルド・ダールのイラストレーター、クエンティン・ブレイクの古典的なスタイルを模倣してください: 抑制のないペンのライン、ワックス…
haohaoxue:quentin-blake-cartoon.prompt: Create an illustration in the exact style of Quentin Blake, the beloved illustrator of Roald Dahl books. Loose, energetic ink line work with slightly scratchy pen strokes. Watercolor and crayon washes as fill — never perfectly within the lines. Two expressive cartoon characters interacting: a wild-haired absent-minded professor and a delighted gap-toothed child in a chaotic garden with books flying everywhere. Exaggerated facial expressions and gestural body language. Wildflowers, garden plants, or simple interior props as background. Off-white or cream paper background. Playful hand-lettered style title if text needed. The spontaneous, joyful energy of classic British children's book illustration. 9:16 vertical.

haohaoxue:couture-evening-gown.title: オートクチュールのイブニングドレス
haohaoxue:couture-evening-gown.description: オートクチュールのイブニング ドレス、宮殿や劇場のシーンで比類のない優雅さを示すゴージャスなドレス、ファッション王国の究極のエディトリアル大ヒット作。
haohaoxue:couture-evening-gown.prompt: Create a breathtaking haute couture evening gown fashion editorial. Model in magnificent ball gown or column dress by Alexander McQueen — dramatic sculpted black gown. Grand architectural setting: opera house, palace ballroom, or museum. Dramatic theatrical lighting. The gown as sculpture. Valentino, Giambattista Valli, or Elie Saab visual language. 2:3.

haohaoxue:traditional-hanfu-editorial.title: 漢服ファッション編集の大ヒット作
haohaoxue:traditional-hanfu-editorial.description: 漢服ファッション編集の大ヒット作、自然の山や川の間を優雅に流れる古代中国の衣装、現代ファッションで再解釈された伝統的な服装の美学。
haohaoxue:traditional-hanfu-editorial.prompt: Create a beautiful hanfu traditional Chinese clothing fashion editorial. Model in flowing silk hanfu — Wei or Tang dynasty style — in natural setting: bamboo grove, lotus pond, or ancient architecture. Fabric movement in wind. Natural light. Cultural poetry combined with fashion photography. 2:3.

haohaoxue:torii-sunset-itsukushima.title: 水鳥居夕日
haohaoxue:torii-sunset-itsukushima.description: 厳島神社の水鳥居に沈む夕日。潮が満ちると、金色の水面に朱色の鳥居が浮かび上がります。日本で最も美しい神聖な風景の一つです。
haohaoxue:torii-sunset-itsukushima.prompt: Create a breathtaking photograph of Itsukushima floating torii gate at sunset. The iconic vermilion torii reflected in still high-tide water, blazing orange and gold sunset sky behind. Minimal boat or figure for scale. Long exposure smoothing the water. One of Japan's most iconic sacred landscapes. 16:9.

haohaoxue:sumi-e-ink-painting.title: 水墨画
haohaoxue:sumi-e-ink-painting.description: 白くて濃い墨が絡み合った日本の水墨画（水墨画）は、わずか数ストロークで万物の魅力を捉え、東洋哲学の視覚的本質を表現します。
haohaoxue:sumi-e-ink-painting.prompt: Create a traditional Japanese sumi-e ink brush painting of a lone bamboo grove swaying in morning mist. Masterful brushwork with varying ink density — dark saturated strokes and dry feathered brushwork. Extensive negative space (ma) as compositional element. Subject: bamboo, plum blossom, mountain, or tiger. Rice paper texture. Seals and haiku calligraphy. 4:3.

haohaoxue:cultural-costume-portrait.title: 伝統的な衣装を着た民族の肖像画
haohaoxue:cultural-costume-portrait.description: 伝統的な民族衣装を着た肖像画、精巧な刺繍やアクセサリーは文化の本質を記録しており、人文科学と美学を組み合わせたビジュアルアーカイブです。
haohaoxue:cultural-costume-portrait.prompt: Create a dignified traditional costume portrait of Miao ethnic minority of Guizhou — elaborate silver headdress and embroidered costume. Subject wearing authentic traditional garments with intricate embroidery, jewelry, and headdress. Natural light or softbox that honors the textile details. Respectful documentary photography. Rich textile texture visible. Cultural heritage documentation quality. 2:3.

haohaoxue:studio-gel-lighting.title: カラージェルスタジオポートレート撮影
haohaoxue:studio-gel-lighting.description: ポートレートはカラージェル照明スタジオで撮影されます。マルチカラーの照明が登場人物の顔に劇的な色のセグメンテーションを投げかける、現代アートの写真。
haohaoxue:studio-gel-lighting.prompt: Create a colored gel studio portrait photograph. Model lit by multiple colored gels — one side deep magenta, other side electric blue, with split lighting creating dramatic color division across the face. Pure black studio background. High contrast skin tones. Fashion-forward creative photography. 4:5.

haohaoxue:ukiyo-e-modern-fusion.title: 浮世絵モダンフュージョンイラスト
haohaoxue:ukiyo-e-modern-fusion.description: 浮世絵と現代の要素を視覚的に融合させた伝統的な木版画のスタイルは、現代の都市の風景を描き、古代と現代の間の対話を生み出します。
haohaoxue:ukiyo-e-modern-fusion.prompt: Create a Ukiyo-e style woodblock print illustration fusing traditional with modern: classic Hokusai or Hiroshige style but depicting a vintage red Ferrari 250 GTO racing through rain. Hand-carved woodblock print texture. Limited palette with flat areas. Bold black outlines. Diagonal rain or wave pattern. Poetic fusion of eras. 2:3.

haohaoxue:chinese-new-year-poster.title: 中国の旧正月春節ポスター
haohaoxue:chinese-new-year-poster.description: 中国の春節をテーマにしたポスターは、伝統的な切り紙と伝統的な中国絵画の筆致を組み合わせたもので、東洋の新年の祝福を伝えるためにお祝いの赤と金の色が特徴です。
haohaoxue:chinese-new-year-poster.prompt: Create a Chinese New Year celebration poster. Traditional paper-cut silhouettes of zodiac animal and auspicious elements — peony, lanterns, fireworks. Ink wash painting background with red and gold as dominant palette. Bold Chinese calligraphy blessings. Woodblock print texture. Festive and culturally rich. 3:4 ratio.

haohaoxue:ghibli-village-scene.title: ジブリ風の田園村
haohaoxue:ghibli-village-scene.description: ジブリアニメ風の牧歌的な村、緑の山小屋と黄金色の午後、宮崎駿の優しい世界観。
haohaoxue:ghibli-village-scene.prompt: Create a Studio Ghibli-inspired countryside village scene. Rolling green hills with a picturesque village of stone and timber houses, windmill, herb gardens. Warm golden afternoon light with dramatic cumulus clouds. A small girl in a sundress walking down a cobblestone path. Wildflowers in foreground. Painterly background inspired by Howl's Moving Castle and Kiki's Delivery Service. Nostalgic hand-painted quality. Ratio 16:9.

haohaoxue:dragon-rider-anime.title: 壮大なドラゴンナイトアニメ
haohaoxue:dragon-rider-anime.description: 壮大なドラゴン ナイト アニメーションの大ヒット作。騎士とドラゴンが雲の上を舞い、壮大な空と神話レベルの衝撃をもたらします。
haohaoxue:dragon-rider-anime.prompt: Create an epic dragon rider anime illustration. A heroic anime warrior riding a magnificent dragon soaring above dramatic cloud formations. The dragon has detailed scales and powerful wings spread wide. Blazing sunset or dramatic stormy sky background. Motion and speed implied by cloud streaks. Epic fantasy anime movie poster quality — inspired by Dragon Ball, Made in Abyss level of artistic detail. Cinematic widescreen 16:9.

haohaoxue:japanese-festival-night.title: 日本の夏祭りの夜
haohaoxue:japanese-festival-night.description: 日本の夏祭りの夜には、廊下に並ぶ赤提灯や、浴衣を着た女の子たちの姿、そして花火がとても美しく、人々に夏を思い出させます。
haohaoxue:japanese-festival-night.prompt: Create a vibrant Japanese summer festival (matsuri) night photograph. Row of red paper lanterns (chochin) lining a festival street, their warm light reflecting on wet cobblestones. Girl in colorful floral yukata in middle distance. Festival food stalls (yatai) with their warm lights. Possibly fireworks (hanabi) illuminating the sky. Bokeh lights from lanterns. Warm nostalgic film photography quality. Ratio 4:5.

haohaoxue:cherry-blossom-alley.title: さくら横丁
haohaoxue:cherry-blossom-alley.description: ピンクの花びらが空一面に舞う日本の桜並木と、詩的な距離に続く古い石畳の道は、最も美しい春の誘いです。
haohaoxue:cherry-blossom-alley.prompt: Create a breathtaking cherry blossom alley photograph in Japan. A narrow stone-paved path flanked by ancient cherry trees in full bloom — thick overarching branches creating a pink floral tunnel. Fallen petals covering the ground and floating in the air. Soft spring morning light filtering through blossoms. Possibly a traditional gate or lantern in background. Film photography aesthetic with Kodak Portra colors. Ratio 4:5.

haohaoxue:underwater-fashion-portrait.title: 水中ファッションの大ヒット作
haohaoxue:underwater-fashion-portrait.description: 水中ファッション写真の大ヒット作、なびく生地や吊り下げられた髪が光を屈折させ、夢のような深海ファッション ショーを作り出します。
haohaoxue:underwater-fashion-portrait.prompt: Create an editorial underwater fashion photography portrait of a model submerged in crystal clear water. Flowing silk fabric billowing around the body in slow-motion suspension. Hair floating weightlessly. Dramatic caustic light rays filtering down from surface. Saturated teal-blue water tones, contrasted against vibrant fashion. Bubbles and refraction adding surreal texture. High fashion editorial quality. Ratio 2:3.

haohaoxue:mecha-anime-poster.title: メカアニメポスターアート
haohaoxue:mecha-anime-poster.description: 水彩とインクを混ぜたメカポスター、戦場跡に立つ全身モビルスーツ、壮大な星雲の背景、日本語のタイポグラフィシール装飾、ハイディテール...
haohaoxue:mecha-anime-poster.prompt: Mecha anime poster in {argument name="style" default="watercolor and ink wash style"}, vertical layout, epic and dramatic. Center: Full-body {argument name="robot colors" default="white, blue, and red"} mobile suit robot with large pink-red energy wings, holding a long beam sword and rifle, standing on a battlefield with city ruins. Above it: Close-up of the robot's head with glowing green eyes, gold V-fin, and red shoulder armor marked {argument name="model code" default="X42S"}. Background: Space battle scene with multiple mobile suits, explosions, and a pink-purple nebula. Right side: Side profile of a young male anime character with dark hair. Bottom: Silhouettes of 4 people standing together. Design elements include emblem logo, Japanese vertical text, large title typography, barcode. Color palette: off-white background, red, pink, blue, gray, gold accents. Mix of traditional ink brush strokes and digital airbrush effects. High detail, cinematic lighting, dynamic composition, poster art style.

haohaoxue:3d-cartoon-character.title: 3D漫画のキャラクター
haohaoxue:3d-cartoon-character.description: 非常に誇張されたプロポーションを備えた 3D CGI 漫画アバター、非常に柔らかいマット素材、強い視覚的コントラストを持つ飽和したグラデーションの背景、コミック...
haohaoxue:3d-cartoon-character.prompt: Extreme 3D CGI cartoon of {argument name="character" default="a chubby corgi puppy wearing a tiny golden crown"} extremely exaggerated proportions and oversized features for maximum comic effect. Head and shoulders portrait photo, incredibly styled with bold and dramatic expressions. Ultra soft matte materials. Character perspective. Saturated {argument name="background color" default="orange gradient"} background that creates a strong visual contrast. Soft lighting and ambient shadows for depth.

haohaoxue:streetwear-fashion-poster.title: ストリートファッションポスター
haohaoxue:streetwear-fashion-poster.description: ハイアングルのトップダウン構図、コンクリートの床に立つストリートファッションの男性モデル、シザーハンドの強制遠近感、35mmフィルムルック、Z世代...
haohaoxue:streetwear-fashion-poster.prompt: Ultra-realistic streetwear fashion campaign poster shot from a high-angle top-down perspective of a stylish young man standing on concrete pavement, reaching one hand toward the camera with a peace sign in forced perspective. He has textured curly mullet hair with a low taper fade, light mustache and beard stubble, sharp jawline, confident relaxed expression, and natural tan skin. Wearing an {argument name="shirt details" default="oversized faded charcoal gray Stüssy t-shirt"}, {argument name="pants details" default="loose blue jeans"}, {argument name="shoes" default="black-and-white Converse sneakers"}, including handwritten-style text, small paragraph blocks, logos, QR code, and fashion campaign aesthetic. Background should remain simple raw concrete texture. Vertical poster format, high-fashion editorial look, natural shadows, 35mm lens feel, photorealistic, trendy Gen Z street style.

haohaoxue:kodak-portra-magazine.title: コダック ポートラ マガジン スタイルのポートレート
haohaoxue:kodak-portra-magazine.description: Kodak Portra 400 フィルムの特徴的なカラー グレーディング - 乳白色のハイライト、暗い領域の明るさ、肌の色合いの正確な再現など。
haohaoxue:kodak-portra-magazine.prompt:
Create a fashion editorial portrait of a young East Asian woman with natural wavy hair shot on Kodak Portra 400 film. Location: golden hour rooftop with city skyline. The model is styled in relaxed chic.

Film characteristics: Portra 400's signature milky highlights with slight halation, lifted shadows revealing shadow detail, accurate warm skin tone reproduction, gentle grain structure visible at 100%. Greens are slightly desaturated shifting toward olive. Blues remain cool and crisp.

Lighting: available natural light as primary source, possibly supplemented with white reflector for fill. The light should feel effortless and unmanipulated. Lens: 85mm portrait equivalent, f/2 shallow depth of field, buttery background bokeh. Slightly underexposed ⅓ stop for richer tones.

Mood: sophisticated, unhurried, the photograph feels found rather than made. Slight organic imperfection—a small breath blur, the model mid-blink or mid-laugh. Magazine quality but with soul. Ratio 2:3.

haohaoxue:anime-popup-business-card.title: アニメーション立体ポップアップ名刺
haohaoxue:anime-popup-business-card.description: 名刺からアニメキャラクターが飛び出し、その半身が紙の上で立体的に表現される、3Dだまし絵とアニメキャラクターデザインが見事に融合した作品です。
haohaoxue:anime-popup-business-card.prompt:
Create a trompe-l'oeil 3D pop-out business card featuring a cyberpunk hacker girl with neon blue hair and holographic glasses. The business card itself is realistically rendered—white card stock with clean typographic layout showing a name, title, and contact details. From the center of the card, an anime-style character bursts outward in full 3D relief, their upper body dramatically emerging above the flat card surface.

The character interacts with the card's physical plane—hands gripping the card's edge, foot braced against the bottom border, creating convincing depth. The emergence point shows the card torn or bent around the figure. Dramatic studio lighting with hard shadows falling on the card surface from the 3D figure.

Art style: high-quality anime illustration meets photorealistic card rendering. Background: clean gradient studio white. The card casting a crisp shadow on the surface below. Scale should feel dramatic—the character nearly as tall as the card is wide. Ratio 4:3.

haohaoxue:dark-fantasy-swordswoman.title: ダークファンタジーの剣姫
haohaoxue:dark-fantasy-swordswoman.description: 月明かりの下、黒い鎧を着た剣士、映画レベルのファンタジーイラスト。刃に魔力が流れ、スカートの間から星の欠片が飛び散る。
haohaoxue:dark-fantasy-swordswoman.prompt:
Illustrate a dark fantasy swordswoman: a silver-haired warrior in black obsidian armor with glowing red eyes. She stands in a dramatic cinematic pose under a shattered full moon, midnight blue sky scattered with star fragments that spiral downward like snow. Her armor is dark midnight black with intricate silverwork engravings, her cape shredded at the edges and caught in a supernatural wind.

Her sword channels ethereal energy—pale blue-white magic flows along the blade in luminous threads, crackling at the tip. Her expression is fierce yet melancholic, hair loose and wild. One eye glows with arcane light.

Lighting: rim light from the fractured moon behind her, primary light from the magical sword, deep shadows on her face. Color palette: midnight blue, silver, pale arcane white, flashes of cold purple. Cinematic composition with extreme vertical format, strong figure silhouette against the moonlit sky. Epic illustration quality, detailed. Ratio 9:16.

haohaoxue:luxury-skincare-ad.title: 高級スキンケア製品の広告の大ヒット商品
haohaoxue:luxury-skincare-ad.description: ハイエンドのスキンケア製品広告の究極の美学 - 暗い背景、劇的な光と影、液体の飛沫、そして製品との完璧な出会い。
haohaoxue:luxury-skincare-ad.prompt:
Create a cinematic luxury skincare product advertisement for LUMIÈRE Sérum Éclat. Dark studio background fading to absolute black. The product—an elegant glass bottle or jar—sits as the primary hero, lit with dramatic single-source lighting that creates sharp specular highlights and deep, rich shadows.

Surround the product with a dynamic frozen-moment splash: translucent serum or water erupting upward, droplets suspended mid-air, catching the light as perfect spheres. Floating botanical elements—white orchid petals, gold leaf fragments, or fresh herb sprigs—orbit the scene at varying distances.

Texture emphasis: cold glass clarity, liquid surface tension, velvet matte packaging. Color palette: deep charcoal black, warm champagne gold, pure white light. One accent color from the brand (rose, jade, or midnight blue). Photorealistic commercial photography quality, 4K. Ratio 4:5.

haohaoxue:wabi-sabi-poetry-poster.title: ミニマルな侘び寂びの詩ポスター
haohaoxue:wabi-sabi-poetry-poster.description: 日本の侘び寂びの美学――不完全さの美しさ、哀悼の念、そしてミニマルな余白。枯れた蓮の枝と一句の詩で十分だ。
haohaoxue:wabi-sabi-poetry-poster.prompt:
Design a wabi-sabi poetry poster for "In imperfection lies the perfect beauty of transience.". Embrace the Japanese philosophy of imperfection, impermanence, and incompleteness. The composition should breathe—vast negative space, a single withered branch or cracked pottery fragment occupying one corner, the poem set in elegant minimal typography.

Texture is essential: aged rice paper with visible fiber grain, subtle watercolor washes in diluted ink grey and pale ochre, brush stroke marks at the margins. Typography: refined vertical or diagonal placement, classical Chinese or Japanese typeface, small and unhurried. No decoration beyond what already exists in the texture.

Color range: off-white, warm grey, diluted sumi ink, one breath of pale moss green or stone blue. The mood is quiet, contemplative, slightly melancholic—like an ink painting left to dry in afternoon light. Ratio 3:4.

haohaoxue:retro-film-collage.title: 懐かしいフィルムコラージュ写真
haohaoxue:retro-film-collage.description: 1970 年代と 1980 年代のレトロなフィルムの美学、複数の古い写真、手書きのテキスト、スタンプ、テープを重ね合わせて、物語性のあるコラージュを形成します。
haohaoxue:retro-film-collage.prompt:
Create a retro film collage photograph featuring a young woman wandering through 1970s Tokyo. Layer multiple vintage photographs of different sizes, angles, and ages—some faded, some over-exposed, some with light leaks and film grain. The main subject should emerge from this layered composition.

Intersperse physical ephemera: Polaroid frames, yellowed newspaper clippings, airmail envelopes, dried flowers pressed flat, vintage stamps, old ticket stubs, washi tape strips in muted earth tones. Add handwritten annotations in pencil and faded blue ink—dates, captions, fragments of poetry.

Color grade: Kodak Portra 400 warmth—milky highlights, lifted blacks, soft grain, desaturated greens pushing toward olive. Slight vignette at corners. The overall mood evokes memory, nostalgia, and the material weight of preserved moments. Aspect ratio 3:4.

haohaoxue:biomechanical-lotus.title: バイオメカニクスとバイオミメティックの融合
haohaoxue:biomechanical-lotus.description: 有機生命と精密機械の究極の融合――血管は回路に、骨はチタン合金のフレームに、生命と機械の境界はアメリカにある――。
haohaoxue:biomechanical-lotus.prompt:
Create a biomechanical fusion artwork featuring a lotus flower in full bloom. Organic forms merge seamlessly with mechanical components—veins become fiber-optic circuits, bones transform into polished titanium frameworks, petals unfurl as precision-engineered gears.

The fusion should feel inevitable rather than forced: biological textures (skin, membrane, wood grain) transition naturally into cold metal surfaces, circuit traces, and hydraulic joints. Ultra-detailed macro rendering with dramatic chiaroscuro lighting. The mechanical parts show real engineering logic—bearings, actuators, structural ribs—while the organic elements retain their natural beauty.

Background: deep black with subtle iridescent fog. Color palette: warm gold and rose gold for organic parts, cool gunmetal and chrome for mechanical. Add micro-details like oil droplets on metal, bioluminescent veins, and hairline weld seams. Photorealistic quality, cinematic depth of field. Square 1:1.

haohaoxue:chinese-ink-poster.title: 墨アニメーションポスター
haohaoxue:chinese-ink-poster.description: 和墨アニメーション風、ライスペーパーの質感、余白の多さ、そして自然と絵の中に筆書風のタイトルが映えるビジュアルポスター。
haohaoxue:chinese-ink-poster.prompt:
Design a visual poster with an Oriental ink animation temperament for a lone crane in flight. The overall principle: heavy ink for structure, light color for atmosphere, negative space for narrative, and edges for breathing. Background: warm rice paper texture with natural off-white and light blue-grey smudging, showing paper grain, water marks, and ink diffusion.

Core text layout is not fixed but responds intelligently to the subject's movement, gaze, and negative space—titles can appear left, right, top, bottom, or diagonally, growing naturally as part of the image rather than added in post-production.

The main title is a heavy ink visual anchor in handwritten calligraphy with thick, moist, irregular strokes including dry-brush effects and smudged edges—like children's picture books and Chinese ink animation titles. Keep moderate negative space in the center. Add theme-appropriate edge elements such as bamboo leaves. Colors appear mainly at edges and corners; center remains restrained and clean.

Overall temperament: poetic, childlike, Oriental warmth, hand-drawn. Ratio 9:16.

haohaoxue:lineart-girl-red-flower-minima.title: シンプルな線画の女の子と赤い花のイラスト
haohaoxue:lineart-girl-red-flower-minima.description: ミニマルなペン線画の女の子のシルエット、風になびくローカットの背中の開いたロングスカート、咲き誇る赤いケシ、そして余白たっぷりの純白の背景…。
haohaoxue:lineart-girl-red-flower-minima.prompt: Extremely minimalist fine line art illustration, a young woman shown in full-body side silhouette profile, hair pulled back into a loose low bun with wispy strands, a calm serene expression, wearing a long flowing high-neck dress with long sleeves, the dress fabric rendered in loose flowing pen lines suggesting movement in a breeze, delicate flat sandals. She holds a single stem of blooming red poppy flowers with several open blossoms and buds down at her side, rendered in vivid red and green watercolor coloring as the only colored elements in the entire illustration. The rest of the figure and dress are pure black fine-line pen drawing on a completely blank white background with no other elements. Extremely elegant negative space composition, delicate confident linework, minimalist fashion illustration aesthetic, 1:2 tall vertical

haohaoxue:kunming-travel-collage-poster.title: 昆明春城旅行コラージュポスター
haohaoxue:kunming-travel-collage-poster.description: 昆明のランドマークの建物に重ねられた紫色のジャカランダの花の海の中での二重露光のポートレート、複数の実際の旅行写真のコラージュアレンジメント、クラフト紙の旅行ラベルなど...
haohaoxue:kunming-travel-collage-poster.prompt: Nostalgic travel poster celebrating Kunming, a wide-angle photograph of a quiet tree-lined street canopied by blooming purple jacaranda trees, soft petals drifting through the air and scattered on the pavement below, warm afternoon sunlight filtering through the purple blossoms. Around the edges of the composition, several smaller inset travel photographs arranged collage-style: a close-up of purple jacaranda blossom clusters against a blue sky, a traditional Chinese stone archway monument framed by flowering branches, a distant lake with hills at sunset, a small vintage postmark stamp graphic. Top of the poster: large elegant Chinese calligraphy brush characters "昆明" with English "Kunming" in elegant script beneath, small vertical Chinese and English text about flowers blooming everywhere in the spring city. Left side: a vintage kraft-paper travel tag design showing "目的地 DESTINATION" "昆明 KUNMING" a date, and "春城记忆 SPRING CITY MEMORY" text, with a circular rubber stamp design reading "KUNMING SPRING CITY" with a flower icon. Bottom: small Chinese and English text about time becoming gentle in Kunming, with a small camera icon doodle. Warm nostalgic purple, cream, and dusty pink color grading throughout, layered scrapbook travel journal aesthetic, 4:5 vertical

haohaoxue:japanese-grandma-sticker-pack.title: 日本のおばさんキャラクター表現パックステッカーセット
haohaoxue:japanese-grandma-sticker-pack.description: 干支グリッドの漫画の叔母の表情ステッカー、パーマして染めた巻き毛、ヒョウ柄のドレスは日常の感情を誇張しており、各グリッドには日本の流行語のバブルが装備されています...
haohaoxue:japanese-grandma-sticker-pack.prompt: Cheerful cartoon sticker pack illustration, a 3×4 grid of twelve individual stickers all featuring the same recurring character: a middle-aged Japanese woman with a permed curly brown updo hairstyle, round glasses (in some panels), wearing a leopard-print cardigan and colorful floral outfits, exaggerated comedic facial expressions and body language in each panel matching a different everyday emotion or situation. Each sticker shows the character in a distinct pose: giving an enthusiastic thumbs up, panicking dramatically over a boiling pot on the stove, cheering with a fist pump, doing a confident thumbs up while holding a notebook, waving cheerfully while shopping, jogging energetically in a tracksuit, sitting exhausted looking sad, fanning herself dramatically looking overheated, gesturing gracefully with a flowing motion, sipping tea contentedly from a teapot, pointing firmly at a moving box, clasping hands together with a delighted sparkly expression. Each sticker has a large bold colorful Japanese text word or phrase in a speech-bubble-adjacent comic font positioned above or beside the character matching her expression (like "well done", "oh no", "here we go", "nice", "next", "one more round", "it's over", "too hot", "good flow", "reset", "put it there", "wonderful"), each text outlined with a thick white border for sticker readability. Clean white background behind each character, vibrant flat cartoon coloring, thick black outline character design, LINE messaging app sticker pack aesthetic, 4:5 vertical

haohaoxue:scorpio-horoscope-daily-infogr.title: 蠍座の今日の星占いかわいいインフォグラフィック
haohaoxue:scorpio-horoscope-daily-infogr.description: ピンクの水彩画のバラの枠で装飾された星占いカード。全体的な健康、愛、キャリア、富を示す 4 つの円形のイラストが含まれています。
haohaoxue:scorpio-horoscope-daily-infogr.prompt: Adorable pastel pink horoscope daily forecast infographic card, decorative watercolor pink roses and vine border running along all four edges of the composition with small sparkle accents. Top: bold black Chinese title text reading "Scorpio Daily Horoscope" with a scorpio zodiac symbol icon, small sparkle icons on either side. Below: two small text boxes side by side showing "Lucky Number: 0" and "Lucky Color: Rose Pink" (rose pink swatch highlighted). Center: a 2×2 grid of four circular illustrated icon scenes, each with a Chinese label above it and a short descriptive Chinese phrase below: top-left circle shows a cute illustrated girl sitting on a crescent moon over water labeled "Overall Fortune" with text about emotional fluctuation and staying calm; top-right circle shows a broken heart illustration between a cartoon man and woman arguing labeled "Love Fortune" with text about avoiding conflict and more tolerance; bottom-left circle shows a person sitting at a desk working by a window with books and a plant labeled "Career Fortune" with text about focusing on oneself and steady progress; bottom-right circle shows a glass jar filled with coins and cash with small money bags and a growing plant labeled "Wealth Fortune" with text about rational spending and gradual saving. Bottom: two small icon rows showing a compass labeled with a lucky direction and a clock labeled with a lucky time, plus a lucky compatible zodiac sign label. Very bottom: a centered gentle closing Chinese blessing phrase. Soft pastel pink and cream color palette, cute hand-drawn illustration style, warm healing social media graphic aesthetic, 4:5 vertical

haohaoxue:ootd-lineart-male-fashion-sket.title: 紳士服線画スケッチ注釈図
haohaoxue:ootd-lineart-male-fashion-sket.description: 罫線入りのノート用紙の背景に男性の服装の手描きの線画スケッチ、キャメルのタートルネックと黒のタイツと組み合わせた茶色のスエード ジャケット、矢印...
haohaoxue:ootd-lineart-male-fashion-sket.prompt: Casual hand-drawn fashion sketch illustration on a lined notebook paper background with visible faint horizontal ruled lines and a red margin line down the left side. A confident young man with short styled dark hair and a neat beard walks forward in three-quarter view, rendered in loose expressive pencil and pen sketch linework with cross-hatch shading, wearing a burnt orange shearling-collar bomber jacket over a beige ribbed turtleneck knit sweater, black skinny jeans, tan suede Chelsea boots, a gold wristwatch, one hand in pocket. Bold handwritten-style black marker title "OOTD" underlined at the top with small motion scribble marks. Scattered handwritten annotation labels with arrows pointing to each garment: "Burnt Orange Shearling Jacket" pointing to the jacket with a small scribble icon, "Beige Turtleneck Knit" pointing to the sweater with a small clothing icon sketch, "Black Skinny Jeans" pointing to the pants, "Tan Suede Chelsea Boots" pointing to the boots with a small boot icon sketch, "Gold Watch" pointing to the wrist with a small watch icon sketch, plus mood/style keyword annotations "DESERT VIBES" and "LAYERS" with small scribble underlines scattered around the figure. Monochrome black pencil and pen sketch aesthetic on cream notebook paper, casual fashion journal sketch style, 1:2 tall vertical

haohaoxue:ootd-paris-polaroid-annotation.title: パリのストリート OOTD ポラロイド衣装の注釈
haohaoxue:ootd-paris-polaroid-annotation.description: パリの路上のカフェのテーブルにポラロイド写真があります。写真では、ラクダのタートルネックのセーター、短いスカート、ブーツを着た女の子が、白い手でふざけてジャンプしています。
haohaoxue:ootd-paris-polaroid-annotation.prompt: Creative OOTD fashion photograph with a photo-within-photo concept. A round wooden outdoor cafe table with scattered golden autumn maple leaves and a ceramic cup of coffee on a saucer, set on a Parisian sidewalk with a blurred cafe storefront and street visible in the background. Resting on the table is a large polaroid-style instant photograph with a white border, and within that polaroid photograph, a three-dimensional effect makes it appear as if a young woman is physically emerging out of the photograph into the real world: her head, torso, and upper body extend above the polaroid's surface in full photorealistic 3D form, wearing a beige ribbed turtleneck sweater and matching beige mini skirt, while her legs in tall brown leather knee-high boots remain flat within the 2D polaroid image below, creating a playful dimensional break effect. She leans forward with a playful pouty expression, one hand reaching toward the camera. White handwritten-style annotation text with thin arrows point to her boots labeled "leather boots", her skirt labeled "mini skirt", and her sweater labeled "clean turtleneck". Small text at the bottom of the polaroid reads "OOTD ESCAPE - PARIS". Warm autumn afternoon lighting, realistic street photography aesthetic merged with creative dimensional photo-manipulation, 4:5 vertical

haohaoxue:chinese-girl-red-door-dragon-m.title: 赤い壁の宮殿の門から頭を突き出す女の子の中国風イラスト
haohaoxue:chinese-girl-red-door-dragon-m.description: 古代の衣装を着た少女が、朱塗りの宮殿の壁の木の扉の後ろに隠れて顔を覗かせます。その後ろには、金色の龍のレリーフの壁画が迫り、ピンク色の桃の花の枝が垂れ下がっています…。
haohaoxue:chinese-girl-red-door-dragon-m.prompt: Rich, painterly Chinese fantasy illustration, a young girl in traditional Hanfu clothing peeks out playfully from behind a tall vermillion-red wooden palace door, only her head, one hand gripping the door edge, and part of her shoulder visible, long dark hair in twin braids adorned with delicate floral hairpins, wearing an embroidered high-collar jacket in cream and teal with intricate patterns, curious bright eyes and a soft shy smile. Behind her, the massive red palace wall is decorated with an ornate golden embossed relief mural of a coiling dragon and phoenix, catching warm dramatic light creating a rich bronze-gold glow against the deep red wall. Traditional grey-green ceramic roof tiles visible at the top edge of the door frame. Cascading branches of pink cherry or peach blossoms drape down from the upper right corner across the frame, delicate pink petals scattered in the air. Rich saturated color palette of deep vermillion red, antique gold, and soft pink, dramatic warm directional lighting creating strong shadow contrast, painterly digital illustration with fine detail on the character and looser atmospheric rendering on the architecture, epic Chinese fantasy game art aesthetic, 9:16 vertical

haohaoxue:vintage-rural-school-photograp.title: レトロな田舎のキャンパスの遊び場のドキュメンタリー写真
haohaoxue:vintage-rural-school-photograp.description: 1980年代から1990年代にかけて、赤レンガのバンガロー教室の外にある田舎の小学校の校庭で、青い布製の学生服を着た子供たちが遊んでいる、バスケットボールスタンド、黒板新聞、スローガンの壁…。
haohaoxue:vintage-rural-school-photograp.prompt: Nostalgic documentary-style photograph of a rural Chinese elementary school courtyard from the 1980s-1990s era. A long red-brick single-story school building with a grey tiled roof and multiple wood-framed windows, faded red painted Chinese slogan characters on the brick wall reading an encouraging educational phrase, a small blackboard mounted outside one classroom door showing simple handwritten arithmetic. A weathered basketball hoop with a worn wooden backboard and a metal rim with an old net stands in the dirt courtyard, a loudspeaker mounted on a wooden pole nearby. Several children in matching worn blue denim-style school uniforms with canvas satchel bags play and walk around the dusty courtyard in various small groups, some sitting on a low wall, some walking with backpacks, captured in candid unposed documentary moments. Bare young trees with sparse leaves planted in a row, tall trees with green foliage in the background. Warm hazy golden-hour sunlight, soft warm color grading with slight film grain texture reminiscent of vintage Kodak film photography, nostalgic collective memory mood, authentic 1990s Chinese rural school aesthetic, 9:16 vertical

haohaoxue:celebrity-caricature-sketch-gr.title: 有名人の風刺画の肖像画のスケッチ 4 つの正方形のグリッド
haohaoxue:celebrity-caricature-sketch-gr.description: 四方格子の白黒ペンシルコミック風の著名人のポートレート、ユーモラスな認識を示すために誇張・拡大された顔の特徴、立体的な質感を生み出す繊細なクロスライン…。
haohaoxue:celebrity-caricature-sketch-gr.prompt: Classic editorial caricature pencil drawing, a 2×2 grid of four separate black-and-white caricature portrait sketches of different distinguished older men, each rendered in the traditional exaggerated caricature illustration style with dramatically enlarged and stylized facial features, dense cross-hatching and fine pencil line shading creating realistic tonal depth and dimension, thin black grid divider lines separating the four panels. Top-left: an elderly royal-looking man with combed-back thinning hair, large expressive furrowed forehead wrinkles, prominent ears, warm slight smile. Top-right: a distinguished middle-aged statesman with short cropped hair, serious stern expression with pursed lips and pronounced jowls, large ears. Bottom-left: an elderly man with a white beard and mustache, weathered wrinkled skin, small wire-rim earring, wise gentle expression, deep character lines. Bottom-right: a middle-aged rock musician with long shaggy hair, dramatically exaggerated large pouting lips, narrow squinting eyes, rugged weathered features. Each portrait exhibits masterful traditional caricature artistry with skillful proportion exaggeration while remaining recognizable, professional illustration magazine caricature style, pure pencil and ink medium, 4:5 vertical

haohaoxue:giant-billboard-car-toy-concep.title: 巨大な看板のおもちゃの車のシュールなコンセプト イメージ
haohaoxue:giant-billboard-car-toy-concep.description: 巨大な看板の女性は腕を伸ばしてミニスポーツカーのモデルを実際の道路に設置しました。通行人は携帯電話を掲げて写真を撮っていた。超現実的でした...
haohaoxue:giant-billboard-car-toy-concep.prompt: Surreal advertising billboard concept photograph, a massive digital billboard mounted on the side of a modern glass office skyscraper displays a close-up photograph of a smiling businesswoman with long brown hair in a navy blazer, sitting at a desk with several small toy sports cars in different colors arranged in front of her, gold cursive quote text on the billboard reading a personal branding tagline with "Just make it fun" beneath it, and a signature and social media handle in the corner. The surreal twist: the woman's illustrated arm and hand physically extend out of the flat billboard screen in three-dimensional photorealistic form, reaching down from the giant billboard into the real city street below, her fingers delicately placing a detailed miniature brown luxury sports car onto the actual asphalt road at a crosswalk. Below on the street, several real pedestrians are photographing the scene in astonishment with their phones raised. Realistic modern city street with cars, crosswalk markings, and glass buildings, bright daytime lighting, seamless photo-composite blending flat 2D billboard content with 3D reality, dramatic scale-bending creative advertising concept, 4:5 vertical

haohaoxue:celebrity-magazine-cover-colla.title: 有名人のファッション雑誌の表紙のコラージュ
haohaoxue:celebrity-magazine-cover-colla.description: ベージュのセーターとデニムのスカートを着た同じ女性スターが描かれた雑誌の表紙のコラージュ、ヴォーグ、バザール、ELL…
haohaoxue:celebrity-magazine-cover-colla.prompt: Fan-made celebrity magazine cover collage poster, a 3×3 grid layout with the center panel larger than the surrounding eight panels. Center: a full-body photograph of a young Asian female celebrity with long straight black hair, standing confidently, wearing an oversized cream cable-knit sweater tucked loosely into a light-wash denim mini skirt, white knee-high socks, white sneakers, one hand in pocket. Surrounding panels each show a different cropped photograph of the same woman (close-up of her eyes, laughing candidly, side profile portrait, sitting on a wooden stool, hands framing her face smiling, three-quarter body shot) styled as different fashion magazine covers, each panel bearing a different famous magazine masthead logo in the top area (Vogue, Elle, Harper's Bazaar, Marie Claire, i-D) rendered in each magazine's signature typography style, with small mock article headline text scattered around each cover mimicking real magazine cover text placement, a small barcode graphic in one bottom corner. Neutral cream and beige color palette throughout matching her outfit, high-fashion editorial photography quality, glossy magazine cover aesthetic, 4:5 vertical

haohaoxue:ancient-greek-philosophers-tim.title: 古代ギリシャの哲学者の歴史的背景のインフォグラフィック
haohaoxue:ancient-greek-philosophers-tim.description: 3 人の哲学者、ソクラテス、プラトン、アリストテレスがアテネの広場で会話しているリアルな油絵のテクスチャ シーン。それぞれのコアは左側にリストされています。
haohaoxue:ancient-greek-philosophers-tim.prompt: Cinematic historical educational infographic poster, a photorealistic oil-painting-style scene of three ancient Greek philosophers seated together in discussion on stone steps within an ancient Athenian agora, warm golden hour sunlight, the Acropolis and Parthenon visible on a hill in the blurred background along with a bustling ancient marketplace crowd. The philosophers: an elderly bearded man in simple white robes gesturing while speaking (Socrates), a middle-aged man in a red-trimmed robe listening thoughtfully (Plato), and a younger bearded man in a brown robe with hands clasped (Aristotle), ancient scrolls resting nearby. Left side of the composition: three stacked text blocks in bold Chinese characters naming each philosopher followed by their core philosophical concepts (questioning method and self-knowledge for Socrates, ideas and the academy and philosopher-king for Plato, logic and classification and empirical observation for Aristotle). Upper right: a winding dotted timeline path curving through the image connecting small circular waypoint markers, each labeled with a historical era in Chinese and date range, progressing from ancient Greek thought through Alexandria, Rome, medieval universities, the Renaissance, the Enlightenment, up to modern science, with an arrow at the top pointing to text about the origin of world civilization history. Small decorative compass and geometric diagram motifs in the corners. Ancient Greek text fragments visible faintly in the upper background like aged manuscript writing. Bottom left corner: a small stack of rolled scrolls with a short poetic Chinese caption about the spark of ideas being lit in Athens illuminating the path of human civilization. Warm sepia and gold cinematic color grading, museum documentary quality, 2:3 vertical

haohaoxue:milan-chibi-travel-sticker-col.title: ミラノの漫画のステッカー旅行コラージュ
haohaoxue:milan-chibi-travel-sticker-col.description: 本物の観光客の後ろ姿がミラノ大聖堂の前に立ち、同じキャラクターの漫画 Q バージョンのステッカーに囲まれて写真を撮ったり、バイクに乗ったり、ピザを食べたりしています...
haohaoxue:milan-chibi-travel-sticker-col.prompt: Playful travel memory collage photograph, a real photograph of a young woman with long curly brown hair, black crop top and wide-leg jeans, standing with her back to the camera looking up at the grand Gothic facade of Milan Cathedral (Duomo di Milano) with its intricate spires and statues, warm overcast daylight. Surrounding this central real photograph, scattered around the composition, are seven small chibi-style cartoon sticker illustrations of the same curly-haired woman character in different cute poses relating to travel activities: waving an Italian flag excitedly, taking a photo with a camera, sitting at a cafe table with coffee and a croissant, riding a small green scooter, eating a large ice cream cone joyfully, reading a paper map looking adorably lost, sitting cross-legged eating a slice of pizza happily. Each chibi sticker has a thin white sticker border. Scattered hand-drawn doodle elements throughout: small pink hearts, sparkle stars, dashed motion lines. Handwritten casual script text captions near each sticker in white and pink (Ciao Milano, Milan you stole my heart, capturing beautiful memories, coffee and dreams, gelato makes everything better, la dolce vita, getting lost in the best way, pizza is always a good idea, grazie milano, not a dream just italy). Bottom right: a small torn-paper style note reading "Milan, Italy" with a checklist (eat well, wander more, fall in love, repeat) in handwritten font. haohaoxue:book-mockup-editorial.description: 自然光の下で本の表紙、書籍、読書シーンを撮影したエディトリアル写真は、知識と美学の両方を重視する文化的な雰囲気を伝えます。
haohaoxue:book-mockup-editorial.prompt: Create an editorial book cover mockup photograph for A Sea of Quiet — a literary fiction novel with linen cover. The book is open or closed on a beautiful natural surface — linen, marble, wooden desk. Golden hour or natural window light. Reading glasses, coffee cup, or flower as supporting props. Intellectual and aesthetic lifestyle mood. 4:5.

haohaoxue:candle-product-mood.title: 豪華なキャンドルの雰囲気写真
haohaoxue:candle-product-mood.description: 豪華な香りのキャンドルの感情的な写真、暗闇の中でのキャンドルの光の穏やかな汚れにより、製品は儀式と生活の質の感覚を伝えることができます。
haohaoxue:candle-product-mood.prompt: Create luxury candle mood product photography for AESOP Petrichor candle. Single or pair of candles lit in dramatic darkness. The warm flame glow is the sole light source, creating intimate amber atmosphere. Marble, dark wood, or concrete surface. Dried botanicals nearby. Minimal props, maximum atmosphere. 4:5.

haohaoxue:backlit-silhouette-dance.title: 逆光のダンスシルエット
haohaoxue:backlit-silhouette-dance.description: 逆光に照らされたダンサーのシルエット写真。動きを止めた優雅な姿勢が、強い光の前では詩的なシルエットに変わり、動きと静けさの完璧なバランスが生まれます。
haohaoxue:backlit-silhouette-dance.prompt: Create a dramatic backlit dance silhouette portrait. Dancer frozen mid-movement — leap, arabesque, or contemporary pose — perfectly silhouetted against intense backlight. Studio strobe behind creates rim light halo. Tutu fabric or flowing costume catching light. Pure artistic movement photography. 2:3.

haohaoxue:close-up-eye-detail.title: 目のマクロクローズアップ
haohaoxue:close-up-eye-detail.description: 人間の目のマクロ写真では、虹彩の質感は宇宙星雲のようであり、極端なクローズアップでは、人体の最も神秘的な器官の壮大な詳細が明らかになります。
haohaoxue:close-up-eye-detail.prompt: Create an extreme macro eye portrait photograph. Single human eye filling entire frame. Iris texture revealed in extraordinary detail — resembling a galaxy or abstract landscape. Catchlight reflection in pupil. Individual eyelashes sharp. Color: blue, green, or amber iris with exceptional detail. Commercial beauty photography quality. 1:1.

haohaoxue:rain-window-portrait.title: 雨窓に映る肖像画
haohaoxue:rain-window-portrait.description: 雨の日にガラス窓の前に映るポートレート、水滴と街の光がぼんやりとした詩を反映し、孤独と思索を描いた感情的な写真です。
haohaoxue:rain-window-portrait.prompt: Create a moody rain window reflection portrait. Face looking out through rain-streaked glass, the outside city lights refracted into bokeh trails through each raindrop. Inside darkness, outside neon glow. Solitude and contemplation mood. Cool blue tones with warm light pops. 2:3.

haohaoxue:double-portrait-diptych.title: ダブルポートレート撮影
haohaoxue:double-portrait-diptych.description: 二人の人物が向かい合ったり、背中を向けたりする肖像画の二連作で、物語の緊張感と感情的な対話の映画レベルの構成を形成します。
haohaoxue:double-portrait-diptych.prompt: Create a cinematic double portrait diptych. Two figures in the same frame, facing each other or back to back. Empty space between them creates tension. Complementary or contrasting: light/shadow, young/old, masculine/feminine. Film still quality — from a story bigger than what we see. 16:9.

haohaoxue:headshot-editorial-male.title: 男性エディトリアルファッションポートレート
haohaoxue:headshot-editorial-male.description: シンプルな背景と強い光と影で描かれた男性ファッションエディターのポートレートは、現代のファッション誌の男らしさと高級感を表現しています。
haohaoxue:headshot-editorial-male.prompt: Create a strong editorial male headshot/portrait. Clean studio or architectural background. Strong architectural lighting — Rembrandt or split light. Sharp jaw, direct gaze into camera. Minimal styling: plain t-shirt or white shirt. Confidence and masculinity. High-end fashion magazine quality. 4:5.

haohaoxue:desert-landscape-portrait.title: 砂漠の風景の肖像画
haohaoxue:desert-landscape-portrait.description: 砂漠の荒野のポートレート、登場人物たちは広大な土地に溶け込み、風、砂、太陽の光が荒々しく詩的な西洋の美学を生み出します。
haohaoxue:desert-landscape-portrait.prompt: Create a cinematic desert landscape portrait. Figure standing in vast desert environment — red rock canyon, sand dunes, or salt flats. Extreme wide angle giving sense of scale. Warm golden light or dramatic storm light. Dust particles in air. Color grade: warm highlights, teal shadows. National Geographic quality. 4:5.

haohaoxue:conceptual-goddess-portrait.title: 神のコンセプトポートレート
haohaoxue:conceptual-goddess-portrait.description: 炎、水流、星などがフィギュアに組み込まれた概念的な神々の肖像画で、別世界の力強さと神話的な気質を生み出しています。
haohaoxue:conceptual-goddess-portrait.prompt: Create a conceptual goddess portrait of goddess of the moon — lunar silver robes, crescent crown. The subject embodies an elemental force — fire goddess with flames woven into hair, water deity with liquid fabric, star goddess with cosmic dust skin. Dramatic ethereal lighting. Otherworldly beauty. High-end composite photography art. 2:3.

haohaoxue:film-noir-portrait.title: フィルム・ノワールの肖像
haohaoxue:film-noir-portrait.description: 1940 年代のハリウッド フィルム ノワール スタイルのポートレート、ベネチアン ブラインドの映写とスモーク、時代を超越した白黒映画の美学。
haohaoxue:film-noir-portrait.prompt: Create a film noir style black and white portrait. Venetian blind shadow stripes across the face from a side window. Cigarette smoke curl. Deep shadows under cheekbones and eyes. Detective office or dimly lit bar setting behind subject. 1940s Hollywood aesthetic. High contrast silver gelatin print quality. 2:3.

haohaoxue:map-illustration-art.title: 手描きのファンタジーマップ
haohaoxue:map-illustration-art.description: 山、海の怪物、コンパス ローズ、中世の地図製作者の想像力と繊細な筆致を備えた、ファンタジーの世界を描いた手描きの地図イラスト。
haohaoxue:map-illustration-art.prompt: Create a hand-illustrated fantasy world map for the ancient Silk Road trade routes connecting East and West. Aged parchment background. Mountains, forests, and seas rendered in medieval cartographic style. Sea monsters and ships in ocean areas. Ornate compass rose. Decorative calligraphy for place names. Aged border frame. Tolkien-inspired map aesthetics. 4:3.

haohaoxue:architectural-blueprint-art.title: 建築設計図アート
haohaoxue:architectural-blueprint-art.description: 建築設計図風の芸術的なイラスト。濃い青色の背景に白い細い線で建築や機械を描いた、究極の合理的な美学です。
haohaoxue:architectural-blueprint-art.prompt: Create an architectural blueprint style art illustration of the Sagrada Família cathedral by Gaudí. White or cyan technical line drawing on deep navy blue background. Multiple views: elevation, section, plan. Fine hatching and dimension lines. Grid overlay. Precise and beautiful technical drafting. 4:3.

haohaoxue:stained-glass-art.title: ステンドグラスの窓アート
haohaoxue:stained-glass-art.description: ゴシック大聖堂のステンドグラスの窓スタイルのアート、鉛分割ガラスの象嵌と光の透過、神聖でゴージャス。
haohaoxue:stained-glass-art.prompt: Create a stained glass window style illustration of a phoenix rising from golden flames. Gothic cathedral aesthetic with lead caming (black outlines) dividing colored glass panels. Jewel-toned translucent colors: ruby red, cobalt blue, emerald green, golden amber. Backlighting effect making colors glow. Biblical or symbolic figurative scene. 2:3.

haohaoxue:mythological-scene.title: 神話の場面イラスト
haohaoxue:mythological-scene.description: 壮大な神話の場面、神と人間の出会い、古典的な油絵の技法を描いたイラストが、東洋と西洋の神話の雄大な勢いを再現しています。
haohaoxue:mythological-scene.prompt: Create an epic mythological scene illustration depicting Athena, goddess of wisdom, emerging fully armored from Zeus's forehead. Gods and mortals in dramatic interaction. Classical oil painting technique: chiaroscuro lighting, dynamic figural composition. Clouds, lightning, divine light. Greek, Chinese, or Norse mythology aesthetic. Renaissance-inspired composition with baroque drama. 16:9.

haohaoxue:linocut-print-art.title: 麻糊プリントアート
haohaoxue:linocut-print-art.description: 麻糊プリント、ナイフ彫刻マーク、ハイコントラストの白黒構図によるプリントアート、独創的で力強い手捺染の美学。
haohaoxue:linocut-print-art.prompt: Create a linocut print style artwork of a lone wolf howling at the full moon on a rocky ridge. Bold black and white high-contrast composition with characteristic gouge marks and cut textures. Organic irregular edges to shapes. No gradients — pure positive/negative space. Handmade print aesthetic. Simple powerful imagery: animal, landscape, or portrait. 2:3.

haohaoxue:infographic-art.title: アートインフォグラフィック
haohaoxue:infographic-art.description: 流れるようなグラフの線とデータの背後にあるストーリーを伝える絶妙なタイポグラフィーを使用して、データの視覚化を芸術作品に変えます。

Data visualization transformed into beautiful illustration — flowing chart lines that form landscapes or figures. Icons hand-illustrated in consistent style. Clear typographic hierarchy. Cohesive color system. Information design meets fine art poster. 4:3.

haohaoxue:concept-art-character.title: キャラクターコンセプトデザイン
haohaoxue:concept-art-character.description: ゲーム、映画、テレビのキャラクターのコンセプト デザイン、3 ビュー ディスプレイと機器の詳細、産業レベルのコンセプト アーティストの創造的な言語。
haohaoxue:concept-art-character.prompt: Create a character concept art sheet for Rei — an ancient forest spirit guardian with flowing moss-covered robes. Front, side, and 3/4 view poses. Detailed costume/armor/equipment design. Color palette swatches. Callout lines indicating material and design notes. Epic fantasy, sci-fi, or steampunk genre aesthetic. Professional game art or film pre-production quality. 4:3.

haohaoxue:retro-travel-illustration.title: レトロな旅行ポスターイラスト

Streamlined shapes with long shadows. WPA poster aesthetic. 2:3.

haohaoxue:fashion-sketch-illustration.title: ファッションデザイン原稿
haohaoxue:fashion-sketch-illustration.description: ファッションデザイナー風の原稿イラスト、スレンダーで滑らかなボディラインの描画と衣服のディテール、ハイファッションの芸術的なノート。

Elongated fashion figure (croquis) in dynamic pose. Loose gestural ink or pencil lines for body structure. Detailed watercolor or marker rendering of the garment. Fabric texture and drape suggested with minimal strokes. Sketchbook aesthetic with handwritten notes. 2:3.

haohaoxue:editorial-caricature.title: エディトリアルコミックイラスト
haohaoxue:editorial-caricature.description: 時事問題解説漫画風のイラスト、誇張されたキャラクターの特徴と鋭い風刺的視点、ニューヨーカー誌レ​​ベルのイラストアート。

Black ink outline with limited color wash. Satirical yet sophisticated humor. 4:3.

haohaoxue:typography-art-poster.title: フォントアートポスター
haohaoxue:typography-art-poster.description: フォントはアートの視覚的なポスターです。言葉自体が絵を構成し、タイポグラフィーがグラフィックになります。現代のフォントデザインの究極の表現です。

Graphic design mastery where type IS the image. 3:4.

haohaoxue:night-sky-astronomy-poster.title: 天文学星空ポスター
haohaoxue:night-sky-astronomy-poster.description: 天文学教育ポスター、深い星雲と星座のパターン、科学とロマンスが共存する宇宙の視覚的な探検。
haohaoxue:night-sky-astronomy-poster.prompt: Create an astronomy night sky educational poster. Deep space photography style showing nebula, star clusters, or constellation map. Rich deep space colors: midnight blue, violet, gold star points. Scientific constellation line overlay with Latin names. Vintage observatory chart meets modern astrophotography. 2:3.

haohaoxue:minimal-exhibition-poster.title: 博物館展示ポスター
haohaoxue:minimal-exhibition-poster.description: ミニマルな展示イメージと正確なレイアウトを備えたモダンな美術館の展覧会ポスターは、高級美術機関の気質を伝えています。
